# kevin

> kevin is a task runner that turns Markdown files (README.md, tasks.md, build.md) into a command line interface: headings marked with `>` become commands and their code blocks become the scripts. It is a small, dependency-free alternative to make and just for project tasks, in the family of mask and xc, written in Zig. An optional `.kevinrc` in the current directory adds or excludes Markdown files (`docs/*.md`, `!draft.md`). Status: early (0.x).

kevin gives each command positional arguments, typed flags (number, string, boolean, choices, required), dependencies (`Requires:`, sync or async, with a job limit), several runtimes (shell, Node/Bun, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Lua, PHP, PowerShell) and a generated `--help`. `kevin --explain <command>` previews what would run without running it, `kevin --introspect` prints the command tree as JSON, and `kevin --from mask|xc` converts existing mask or xc files.

Use kevin when project tasks (test, lint, build, release, setup) should live in documentation that people and coding agents already read. Do not use it for incremental, file-timestamp builds (use make, ninja or Bazel), or when a stable 1.0 interface is required.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/README.md): overview, one-line install, syntax, flags, dependencies, runtimes, comparison with make, just, mask and xc, known limitations
- [Guide for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/docs/for-agents.md): how to discover, preview, run and write kevin tasks, plus a snippet for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/skills/kevin/SKILL.md): a SKILL.md that teaches an agent the kevin syntax and workflow

## Project

- [build.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/build.md): the project's own build, test and release tasks, written as kevin tasks
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): development workflow, commit conventions, CI and releases
- [Releases](https://github.com/mtxr/kevin/releases): prebuilt binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows with SHA256SUMS

## Optional

- [Compatibility tests](https://github.com/mtxr/kevin/tree/main/tests/compat): mask and xc cases, with known gaps tracked as expected failures
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mtxr/kevin/main/LICENSE): MIT
